counting_rule: One row per illustrated text prompt. Two character-continuity stages count separately; four logo variants share one prompt and one row. Runnable Python/Ruby examples repeat logo and cutout workflows.
audit_scope: Read complete selected 2.5 prose and prompts, live verified. Asset HEAD checks confirm accessibility only; no visual quality assessment or image generation performed by this audit.

experimental_controls: Do not infer a backend from product availability; record the model or unknown.
Use same semantic requirements when comparing prose versus structured formatting.
Separate prompts with extra requirements from equivalent-information prompt comparisons.
Prespecify acceptance criteria and show every generated candidate.
Compare sequential and batched edits against the same starting image and final goal.
Match total candidate budget when comparing sub-agent search to a single agent.
Report exploratory single-image comparisons as observations, not general effect sizes.
